COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPCRL No. 1046 of 2026
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik and Mr. 
Junaid Alam, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Pankaj Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the 
State.
3. Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, learned 
counsel for respondent no. 3.
4. By means of the present writ petition, 
petitioner seeks quashing of FIR dated 
24.03.2026 registered as FIR No. 0050 of 
2026, under Sections 318(4) and 351(2) and 
352 of BNS, registered at Police Station 
Jhabrera, District Haridwar.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner would 
submit that in WPCRL No. 576 of 2026, 
Kulwinder Singh Vs. State of Uttarakhand, co￾accused has been granted interim protection 
from arrest by this Court. Learned counsel for 
the petitioner would further submit that only a 
total sum of Rs. 50 Lakhs were transferred in 
the account of the petitioner and the 
petitioner gave the amount of Rs. 50 Lakhs in
cash to the co-accused Kulwinder Singh. 
Besides this, no role has been assigned to the 
petitioner.
6. Heard learned counsel for the parties 
and perused the record.
7. Having considered the submissions, this 
Court is of the view that this matter definitely 
requires deliberation.
8. Issue notice to respondent no. 3,  returnable within four weeks. Steps to be 
taken within a week.
9. List alongwith ABA No. 138 of 2026 and 
WPCRL No. 576 of 2026.
10. Meanwhile, counter-affidavit be filed by 
the State.
11. Till the next date of listing, as an interim 
measure, petitioner shall not be arrested in 
relation to the aforesaid FIR, provided, he co￾operates with the investigation.
12. Stay Application made therefor stands 
disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 05.06.2026
Ujjwal

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
ABA No. 138 of 2026
With 
WPCRL No. 576 of 2026
WPCRL No. 1046 of 2026
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.,
 Mr. Rajendra Singh Azad, learned counsel for the 
applicant through video conferencing in ABA No. 138 of 
2026, Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia, learned Amicus Curiae for 
the petitioner in WPCRL No. 576 of 2026 and Mr. Harsh 
Vardhan Dhanik, learned counsel for the petitioner in 
WPCRL No. 1046 of 2026.
2. Mr. Dinesh Chauhan, learned A.G.A. for the State 
of Uttarakhand. 
3. Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for 
the complainant.
4. Learned State Counsel submits that, during the 
course of investigation, certain additional penal 
provisions have been invoked. He further submits that 
it has come to light that petitioner No. 1- Kulwinder 
Singh, was also arrested in a criminal case in the State 
of Punjab.
5. Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel, submits that 
pursuant to the order dated 30.04.2026 passed by this 
Court in WP(Crl.) No. 576 of 2026, the concerned 
department is conducting an inquiry into the matter and 
seeks four weeks' further time to place the report on 
record.
6. Learned State Counsel further submits that certain 
subsequent developments have taken place and seeks 
permission to bring the same on record by way of an 
additional affidavit.
7. Permission, as prayed for, is granted.
8. List these cases on 17.07.2026.
 (Alok Mahra, J.)
 15.06.2026
 
Shiksha

4. Vide order dated 30.04.2026, the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court had directed 
Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel to 
investigate about the cash transactions, 
which have been alleged in the affidavit filed 
by the complainant.
5. Today, Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel 
has supplied the report before this Court. The 
same is placed on record. He has submitted 
that Income Tax Department is still  investigating the matter regarding the persons 
residing in the State of Rajasthan and the 
report is expected to be received within two 
weeks.
6. Learned State Counsel prays for and is 
granted further two weeks time to comply with 
the order dated 17.07.2026.
7. List this matter on 23.09.2026.
8. Interim order, if any, to continue till 
then.

Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Sr. Advocate, 
assisted by Ms. Disha Vashistha, Advocate for 
the applicant in ABA No. 138 of 2026. Mr. 
H.M. Bhatia, Amicus Curiae for the petitioner 
in WPCRL No. 576 of 2026. Mr. Junaid Alam, 
Advocate for the petitioner in WPCRL No. 
1046 of 2026 and Mr. Akshay Pradhan, 
Advocate for the petitioner in WPCRL No. 
1148 of 2026.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the 
complainant.
4. Today, learned counsel for the State have 
handed over the written instructions, which 
shows that some new sections have been 
added against the applicant. Instructions are 
taken on record. Learned State Counsel 
further submits that the applicant is in 
judicial custody in District Jail, Patiala, State 
of Punjab and the Investigating Officer have 
visited that place and recorded the statements 
of the applicant. As such, the issue that the  applicant is not cooperating in the 
investigation does not survive any more.
5. Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel 
submits that investigation, as directed by this 
Court, is still underway and the report is 
expected to be received soon.
6. List this matter on 14.10.2026.
7. Interim order, if any, to continue till 
then.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 23.09.2026
Ujjwal
